info.title: Project Model configuration, commands and safe available chat API
info.description: Five accepted Owner GET/HEAD resources retain their two-second I/O and 8 MiB complete representation rules. Six configuration mutations and one explicit historical command lookup use the same current Project authority. Mutation publication/I/O budget is 30 seconds, lookup is two seconds; request JSON <=1 MiB and safe success output <=1 KiB. No Provider network invocation, credential material, new selector or Agent reference rewrite is provided.

get.description: Current Human Owner only; administrator has no cross-Owner exemption. Account boundary and same-transaction Session/Owner/gate apply. Exactly one query; no write/lookup/Provider invocation. One two-second publication/I/O budget begins before authentication and includes EOF, service, complete admission/validation/encoding, Body.Close, Write/Flush and callback retirement. No request body; all undocumented, repeated, empty or malformed query parameters and empty ? are rejected; details accept no query. Raw query <=32768 bytes. Timeout/partial I/O aborts rather than publishing a late Problem. Model/Provider configuration includes disabled entries; available-chat-models includes only enabled Provider + Model chat union.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Single nonempty opaque cursor, decoded size <=8192 bytes. No TTL; a retired/unavailable signing kid fails verification. Same current Owner/query binding required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: One canonical decimal value from 1 to 100. No sign, spaces, leading zero, empty value or repetition.

200.description: Complete validated representation within the 8 MiB admission/encoding bound. HEAD performs the same query and encoding with no body.

post.description: Current Human Owner only, no administrator exemption. Strict typed Project input is validated before all service/lookup calls; malformed projection is never masked by a historical lookup. One service call; the original Model Read->receipt->first Mutate order and same-context private Unknown confirmation are unchanged. Archived history replay may succeed under current Read; new mutations still require active Mutate. All query parameters and empty ? are rejected. Input <=1048576 raw JSON bytes, depth<=64, strict duplicate/unknown fields and explicit null/presence. Provider options, parameters/overwrites and reasoning_efforts retain the original unsupported-nonempty policy. Project credential_ref is a same-Project stable ID, never material. No auto retry or key substitution. Actual Body.Close, Write/Flush and callback retirement precede reset; expired/partial I/O aborts. Thirty-second publication/I/O budget before authentication; original earlier parent deadline wins. A nil-error but malformed write receipt maps to private DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE/unknown without inventing cause/attempt or asserting rollback; a service error has priority.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Exactly one original command key; never a URL parameter or regenerated lookup key.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Formal Account CSRF token for all seven unsafe-method operations, including passive lookup.

requestBody.description: One strict application/json object, max1048576 raw bytes including whitespace. Size limit is not a whole-process memory bound.

200.description: Complete safe JSON success, at most1024 bytes; original history, not a current GET replacement.

default.description: Original safe Problem and service error priority. Lookup projection failure is DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE/not_started for unavailable observation; this does not assert an original write did not commit. Unsupported methods use full resource Allow; HEAD errors have no body. Deadline and tail failures abort without a late Problem.
